title: Materials and Production Planning Specialist Conosur
description:
We're Hiring!

Materials and Production Planning Specialist Conosur

At Envu, we partner with our customers to design world-class, forward-thinking innovations that protect and enhance the health of environments around the world. We offer dedicated services in: Professional Pest Management, Forestry, Ornamentals, Golf, Industrial Vegetation Management, Lawn & Landscape, Mosquito Management, and Range & Pasture.

Envu brings together a broad range of perspectives to look beyond chemistry and dare to explore new paths forward. Guided by our inclusive culture, we embrace change and flexibility, tackling our customers' toughest challenges proactively, passionately and with an entrepreneurial spirit.

We pursue our ambitions collaboratively because we know that a unified and empowered team is an unstoppable force, allowing us to achieve our vision of healthy environments for everyone, everywhere. Join Us.

Envu is proud to be Great Place to Work Certified in the U.S., France and India (June 2025 – June 2026)

FUNCTION: Materials and Production Planning Specialist Conosur

LOCATION: São Paulo / Brazil

JOB TYPE: Permanent

ROLE SENIORITY: Managerial

GET TO KNOW YOUR AREA:

Coordinates production with tollers, ensuring alignment with the sales plan, efficient execution, and resolution of conflicts and delays. Plans and manages the availability of materials and active ingredients (AI), executing MRP calculations, purchasing, and logistics coordination with suppliers. Monitors inventory levels, intercompany transfers, and toller performance, supporting continuous improvement in collaboration with supply chain and procurement teams.

YOUR MISSION WILL BE TO:

  • Owns toller coordination, ensuring production scheduling aligns with sales plan and demand priorities while maintaining adherence to frozen periods and committed production slots
  • Coordinates daily/weekly production plans with tollers, ensuring smooth execution by tracking output, resolving scheduling conflicts, and mitigating production delays. Works closely with the senior supply and planning specialist to align production priorities.
  • Monitors production execution, proactively identifying and addressing issues related to toller capacity, material shortages, or unexpected disruptions. Escalates unresolved risks to supply planning and procurement teams.
  • Owns material planning, ensures material availability of AI, co-formulants, and packaging readiness for planned production runs. Collaborates with suppliers and logistics teams to ensure timely deliveries.
  • Tracks and reports toller inventory levels, working with the Inventory Manager to identify potential shortages, excess stock, or discrepancies at toller sites.
  • Feeds production output data into ERP systems, ensuring visibility of completed batches and enabling accurate intercompany transfer orders, stock movements, and replenishment planning.
  • Collaborates with Logistics & Distribution, ensuring timely execution of intercompany transfers for finished goods and AI. Aligns outbound logistics, transportation planning, and carrier coordination to facilitate seamless material movement.
  • Provides input on toller performance, tracking adherence to schedules, production efficiency, and issue resolution. Supports continuous improvement initiatives in collaboration with supply planning and procurement teams.
  • Runs MRP calculations daily/weekly, ensuring accurate material replenishment by validating planning parameters such as lead times, order quantities, and safety stock. Drives improvement in planning accuracy by refining MRP parameters based on supply performance.
  • Updates MRP with supplier feedback, incorporating changes in lead times, production constraints, and delivery schedules to ensure material availability. Works closely with suppliers to proactively adjust for potential delays and optimize material flow.
  • Manages procurement execution, creating and tracking purchase orders for direct materials and AI.
  • Communicates material requirements to suppliers, validating availability against forecasts and ensuring timely deliveries.
  • Coordinates material and AI call-offs, ensuring timely deliveries from suppliers while optimizing logistics flows in collaboration with Distribution & Logistics. Monitors transportation lead times and ensure alignment with toller production schedules.
  • Acts as secondary support as senior supply and planning specialist in Conosur and Brazil according to the business needs.

ARE YOU READY FOR THE ROLE?

Main requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, Business Administration or related fields;
  • APICS certification strongly recommended;
  • Post-graduation is desired;
  • Project Management skills;
  • 3+ years cumulative experience in Supply Chain Planning & Tollers; Inventory Management;
  • Key competencies | Customer Focus, Teamwork, Drives Results, Analytics, Strategic Thinking and Problem Solving;
  • Assertive Communication, Leadership and influencing skills required;
  • Excellent knowledge of advanced planning principles, strategies, and systems;
  • Required fluent Spanish and English;
  • Availability for travel (15%)

Envu is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants, regardless of ethnicity, color, race, religion, origin, age, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other conditions. And all opportunities are open to people with disabilities.

By applying for this position, you agree that your personal data are going to be processed and recorded by Envu for recruitment purposes only. For candidates who are not selected for this position, personal data will be kept for a period of two years and then permanently deleted.

title: Pessoa Especialista de Performance (Foco em Estratégia e OKRs)
description:

Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.

Atenção, Arquitetos de Resultados!

Não estamos procurando apenas um Especialista em Gestão de Performance. Buscamos o profissional que será o motor da nossa cultura de alta performance e o arquiteto do desdobramento estratégico da companhia. Se você é apaixonado por OKRs, respira dados e acredita que a performance individual deve estar diretamente ligada ao sucesso do negócio, seu lugar é aqui.

Seu Desafio Principal:

Você será a referência técnica para traduzir a visão da liderança em metas claras e mensuráveis. Seu papel será garantir que cada colaborador entenda como sua entrega impacta diretamente os resultados da empresa.

Suas Responsabilidades de Alto Impacto:

  • Desdobramento Estratégico e OKRs: Liderar tecnicamente o ciclo de desdobramento estratégico (Top-Down), garantindo que os OKRs (Objectives and Key Results) da companhia sejam implementados de forma clara e consistente em todas as áreas.
  • Performance Data-Driven: Ser o guardião dos dados de desempenho. Isso inclui desenvolver e gerenciar dashboards avançados para o acompanhamento contínuo dos resultados e KPIs.
  • Consultoria Estratégica: Atuar como consultor interno especializado para gestores, treinando-os na escrita de metas de alta qualidade e na condução eficaz de feedback contínuo.
  • Gestão de Ciclo: Gerenciar o ciclo de performance (avaliações, calibração e análise de equidade), garantindo que o processo seja moderno, justo e alinhado aos objetivos de negócio.
  • Inovação de Processos: Buscar ativamente benchmarks de mercado para garantir que nossa metodologia de gestão de performance seja de ponta e gere o máximo impacto.

O que Esperamos de Você:

  • Experiência sólida e comprovada no desenho e gestão de ciclos de OKR ou outras metodologias de Gestão por Resultados.
  • Experiência avançada em People Analytics, análise de dados e criação de dashboards (ex: Power BI, Tableau ou sistemas de gestão de performance).
  • Mindset de Consultor: Capacidade de influenciar a liderança e traduzir dados complexos em insights acionáveis.

O Que Seria um Diferencial:

  • Certificação OKR ou em metodologias ágeis.
  • Experiência prévia na implementação ou gestão de plataformas de Performance/OKRs (como Workday, Gupy, Mereo, Qulture Rocks ou softwares especializados).

title: Arquiteto de Soluções- Oracle
description:
Resumo

Profissional responsável por desenhar, implementar e evoluir soluções de integração e middleware, garantindo escalabilidade, segurança e aderência às melhores práticas de arquitetura. Atua como referência técnica em plataformas SOA / OAG (Oracle API Gateway, Oracle SOA Suite) e em arquiteturas serverless com AWS Lambda, alinhando integrações legadas a soluções modernas em nuvem.

Principais Responsabilidades

Definir e manter a arquitetura de middleware (on-premises e cloud), suportando integrações críticas entre sistemas, parceiros e APIs externas.

Projetar soluções com OAG e Oracle SOA Suite, assegurando governança, segurança e políticas de API.

Liderar a migração e/ou modernização de integrações para AWS Lambda e outros serviços nativos da AWS (API Gateway, SQS, SNS, EventBridge, Step Functions).

Atuar na definição de padrões de integração, protocolos (REST, SOAP, JMS, eventos) e estratégias de mensageria.

Estabelecer guidelines de observabilidade e monitoramento (Dynatrace, CloudWatch, ELK).

Garantir alta disponibilidade e performance em integrações de missão crítica.

Apoiar squads e times de desenvolvimento na adoção de boas práticas de middleware e nuvem.

Conduzir avaliações de impacto técnico e provas de conceito (POCs) em novas tecnologias de integração.

Requisitos Técnicos

Middleware / SOA

Experiência com Oracle SOA Suite (BPEL, OSB, Mediator, Adapters).

Conhecimento profundo em Oracle API Gateway (OAG) e gestão de políticas de segurança (OAuth, JWT, rate limiting, throttling).

Integração via SOAP, REST, JMS, MQ, FTP, DB adapters.

Experiência com arquiteturas orientadas a serviços (SOA) e microsserviços.

Cloud (AWS)

Experiência em AWS Lambda e arquiteturas serverless.

Integração com API Gateway, SQS, SNS, EventBridge, Step Functions.

Conhecimentos em IAM (Identity and Access Management) e segurança em nuvem.

Monitoramento com CloudWatch e boas práticas de observabilidade.

Arquitetura

Definição de roadmaps de modernização para integrações legadas.

Aplicação de padrões de integração (EAI, ESB, event-driven).

Conhecimento em arquitetura de APIs (API-first, design RESTful, OpenAPI/Swagger).

Experiência em middleware híbrido (on-premises + cloud).

Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas.

Desejável

Experiência com Kong, Apigee ou outros API Gateways.

Conhecimento em containers (Docker, Kubernetes, OKE, EKS).

Certificações Oracle ou AWS (ex: AWS Solutions Architect Associate/Professional).

Experiência em projetos com migração para nuvem.

title: Embedded Linux Engineer
description:
Toradex is a global company strongly focused on engineering & technology. We're powered by a diverse & uniquely gifted workforce. We pursue the best people to propel our innovative vision of embedded computing and IoT. If you're interested in being a driving force at an agile technology company, engineering clever computing solutions & helping other companies bring their products to life, we should talk.

As an Embedded Linux Software Development Engineer BSP, you are part of the R&D team, making sure our Linux BSPs and related software offerings for our SoMs (System on Modules) are constantly developed, maintained, and quality improved. The work ranges from initial bring-up, to driver and kernel development, up to build-system, tooling and distro level development.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain Embedded Linux BSPs for Toradex' embedded computer modules
  • Device driver development: optimizations, bug fixing, add new functionality
  • Eco-system: porting of third party software libraries, develop Software tools and utilities from scratch, Boot loader firmware
  • Mainline selected items
  • Suggest improvements related to products, software offerings, documentation, processes, etc. in order to allow continuous improvement
  • Work closely with other team members in an Agile development environment and participate in technical analysis and decisions
  • Communicate your work progress, coordinate with other development teams, and participate in R&D working groups

Skills

  • Expertise in Embedded Linux: Bootloader and Linux Kernel
  • Excellent C language knowledge and programming skills
  • Knowing OpenEmbedded/Yocto Project build system
  • Knowledge of industry standard interfaces and protocols such as I2C, SPI, UART, USB, Ethernet, PCI Express
  • C++/Python/Bash language knowledge and programming skills
  • Demonstrable Electronics knowledge and work experience: the ability to read and understand hardware schematics and datasheets; to use standard development aids such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, bus protocol analyzers, etc. when developing low-level software which interacts directly with machine registers
  • Familiar with communication peripherals (Bluetooth, Ethernet, Wi-Fi)
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Excellent English language skills reading/writing/speaking
  • High-integrity, open, team player

What do we offer

  • Agile, globally oriented and inter-cultural corporate culture.

  • Contemporary employment conditions, modern office space and a flexible working environment.

title: Corporate Communications Manager
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage! Within just one year, Keeta has become an industry leader in Hong Kong. With our ongoing expansions into Saudi Arabia, Keeta achieved the remarkable feat of launching 5 cities in just 17 days, allowing the Arab world to witness the speed of China! Keeta offers exciting opportunities to join a transformative journey that is shaping the future of delivery and retail. Join Keeta, explore the world.

This is an on-site position, 5 days per week at Vila Olimpia.

About the Role:

Keeta is looking for a Corporate Communications Exper to support the execution of our external communications strategy in Brazil. You will work with media, PR agencies, and cross-functional teams to implement campaigns, manage media relations, and maintain brand consistency in a fast-paced tech environment. The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented executor with strong organizational skills and experience in media engagement.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Campaign Execution: Support the rollout of integrated communications initiatives (press releases, media pitches, events) to enhance brand visibility and positive media coverage.
  • Media & KOL Coordination: Assist in managing relationships with journalists and influencers, including scheduling interviews, sharing updates, and tracking coverage.
  • Agency Support: Work with external PR agencies to coordinate deliverables, ensuring alignment with Keeta's messaging and deadlines.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with Marketing, Social Media, Government Affairs, and Internal Comms to implement consistent messaging across channels.
  • Crisis Response: Help monitor and address reputational risks, including drafting holding statements and supporting rapid response efforts.
  • Content & Reporting: Prepare press materials, media lists, and performance reports (e.g., coverage metrics, sentiment analysis).

Requirements:

  • Experience in corporate communications or PR experience, preferably in tech, food delivery, or related sectors.
  • Experience supporting media campaigns, agency coordination, and crisis comms.
  • Strong written and verbal communication in Portuguese and English.
  • Organizational skills to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
  • Familiarity with food/beverage or delivery industries is a plus.

Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a bold vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career. As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences. At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 30 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond. Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

Estamos em busca de um talento analítico e curioso, com paixão por pesquisa e desenvolvimento, para atuar na construção de um conhecimento proprietário sobre ingredientes naturais aplicados à indústria cosmética.

.

title: Production Supervisor/Coordinator - Dry-Mix Mortar & Water-based Coatings Factory
description:
Core Responsibilities:

1. Production Operations & Management

  • Oversee daily production management for both dry-mix mortar and water-based coatings lines. Schedule production tasks according to plan, ensuring production targets are met on time, in quantity, and to quality standards.
  • Supervise the entire production process from material preparation, feeding, and mixing to packaging and palletizing, ensuring smooth and efficient operations at all stages.
  • Strictly execute the production schedule, optimize production cycle times, and improve equipment utilization and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).

2. Team Management & Development

  • Manage daily shift operations, including personnel scheduling, task assignment, work guidance, and on-site discipline supervision.
  • Organize and implement job skill training to enhance team members' operational skills, quality awareness, and safety mindset.
  • Conduct performance evaluations for shift personnel, providing continuous feedback and coaching to build a high-performance team.

3. Quality Management & Control

  • Strictly enforce standard operating procedures and work instructions to ensure process standardization and stability.
  • Monitor in-line product quality, perform regular checks at key quality control points, and prevent the occurrence of batch quality issues.
  • Collaborate with the Quality department to analyze, address, and track quality deviations in production, and implement corrective and preventive actions.

4. Safety Production & 5S Management

  • Act as the primary safety responsible person for the shift, implementing company safety rules and regulations, organizing safety training, and conducting hazard identification.
  • Ensure all employees strictly adhere to safe operating procedures, particularly those related to dust explosion prevention and chemical handling, to eliminate safety accidents.
  • Promote and maintain 5S management in the production area, creating a clean, orderly, and safe working environment.

5. Cost Control & Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor and analyze the consumption of raw materials, energy, and auxiliary supplies, striving to reduce production costs.
  • Assist in analyzing equipment failure causes to reduce unplanned downtime.
  • Proactively identify waste in the production process, actively participate in and lead continuous improvement activities (e.g., Kaizen), and propose合理化建议 (rationalization suggestions).

Mandatory Requirements:

  • College diploma or above in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Inorganic Non-metallic Materials, or related fields.
  • Minimum 5 years of production experience in the building materials industry, including at least 2 years in a Production Team Leader or Supervisor role. Must have production management experience in a dry-mix mortar or water-based coatings factory.
  • Familiar with the production processes, equipment principles, and operational procedures for dry-mix mortar/coatings (e.g., mixers, automatic packing machines, powder conveying systems, liquid mixing & dispersing equipment).
  • Strong team leadership, communication, coordination, and on-site problem-solving skills.
  • Strong quality awareness, cost consciousness, and safety mindset.
  • Ability to adapt to a factory work environment and handle work pressure.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior work experience with Sika or Saint-Gobain is highly preferred.

title: Analista Pl - Qualidade (Auditoria) - Pesquisa Nacional - IDOR SP
description:
Fundado em 2010 no Rio de Janeiro, o Instituto D'Or de Pesquisa e Ensino (IDOR) é uma organização sem fins lucrativos que tem como objetivo contribuir para a evolução da ciência, de forma a melhorar a condição de vida humana. Para isso, combina pesquisa de ponta, capacitação profissional e desenvolvimento tecnológico na área da saúde. Sua principal mantenedora é a Rede D'Or São Luiz (RDSL), maior rede hospitalar privada do Brasil.

Desde sua criação, o IDOR valoriza a ciência e se mantém atento às necessidades do país na área da saúde, mobilizando seus recursos e estimulando seus pesquisadores na busca de soluções para problemas atuais e futuros.

Desta forma, o Instituto trouxe importantes contribuições para a saúde pública nacional e internacional, como no entendimento do papel do vírus Zika nas malformações do sistema nervoso e nas pesquisas voltadas para o enfrentamento da pandemia de covid-19.

A excelência da pesquisa desenvolvida no IDOR viabiliza inúmeras parcerias internacionais e centenas de publicações em revistas científicas de grande prestígio. Além disso, o Instituto também contribui significativamente para a formação de profissionais da área da saúde nas diferentes esferas do ensino, incluindo graduação, pós-graduação stricto sensu, residência médica e multiprofissional, aperfeiçoamento e cursos de capacitação, atividades que deram origem à Faculdade IDOR de Ciências Médicas, fundada em 2017.

Requisitos

A área de Qualidade em Pesquisa Clínica é responsável por assegurar que todos os processos relacionados a ensaios clínicos sejam conduzidos em conformidade com normas nacionais e internacionais, garantindo a integridade científica dos dados, a segurança dos participantes e a aderência regulatória. Atuamos na padronização de processos, execução de auditorias, monitoramento de indicadores e implementação de melhorias contínuas.

  • Formação superior em Enfermagem, Farmácia, Biomedicina, Medicina ou áreas correlatas da saúde;
  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Pesquisa Clínica, Gestão da Qualidade ou Auditoria em Saúde;
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado (leitura e escrita técnica);
  • Espanhol técnico para interface com centros da América Latina;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Boas Práticas Clínicas (ICH-GCP);
  • Familiaridade com a legislação brasileira aplicável (RDC 9/2015, Res. CNS 466/2012, Res. CNS 510/2016);
  • Vivência prévia em auditorias de pesquisa clínica;
  • Conhecimento em auditorias internacionais (FDA, EMA, PMDA);
  • Desejável conhecimento de sistemas eletrônicos (eTMF, CTMS, EDC, eISF);
  • Certificações adicionais desejáveis: Auditor Líder ISO, SOCRA, ACRP ou DIA.

Atividades

  • Planejar, executar e reportar auditorias em centros de pesquisa, patrocinadores e CROs;
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos com classificação de achados e definição de planos de ação;
  • Monitorar a implementação de CAPAs (ações corretivas e preventivas) e avaliar sua eficácia;
  • Apoiar a manutenção e atualização de procedimentos operacionais padrão (POPs);
  • Ministrar treinamentos internos sobre Boas Práticas Clínicas (ICH-GCP) e conformidade regulatória;
  • Contribuir para a preparação e acompanhamento de inspeções nacionais (ANVISA, CONEP) e internacionais (FDA, EMA);
  • Participar da análise de indicadores de qualidade e geração de relatórios gerenciais.

Outras Informações

  • Segunda a quinta-feira das 8h às 18h e sexta-feira das 8h às 17h - 100% Presencial.

Familiaridade com CI/CD pipelines cloud-native, deploy automatizado e ambientes distribuídos.

Participação em iniciativas de modernização ou migração de aplicações legadas para cloud/microsserviços.

title: Strategic Projects Manager
description:
About Vammo

Vammo is building an accessible, resilient, and scalable clean energy network for emerging megacities, starting in Latin America. By combining electric motorcycle subscriptions with a rapidly expanding battery swap infrastructure, we make clean transportation affordable and reliable for the millions who keep cities moving.

Founded in 2022 and headquartered in São Paulo, Vammo has raised $100M from top-tier investors across the globe. Our founders and team represent an incredibly diverse and international group that is built of former executives coming from Tesla, Uber, Rappi, iFood, Loggi, Niu, Jump and others.

We are all deeply motivated by the mission to decarbonize Latin America while simultaneously reducing costs for one of the region's most vulnerable populations.

The next wave of mobility innovation will come not from San Francisco, but from São Paulo. Our operations will soon expand from Sao Paulo to cities across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, proving that real climate impact and transformative business models can be built first where the need is greatest.

About the Role

Vammo is hiring a strategic, high-performing leader to join our Special Projects & Strategy team - a small, elite group working directly with executives and founders - to solve the most complex and high-impact challenges in the company. You'll drive cross-functional initiatives that shape Vammo's growth trajectory - from fleet and asset optimization to financial modeling, new business models, partnerships, and operational scaling.

This is a role for someone who thrives on ambiguity, loves tackling hard problems, and moves seamlessly between data, strategy, and execution. You will be deeply embedded across teams - working hand-in-hand with Fleet, Charging, Maintenance, Sales, Software, and Hardware - and expected to think like an owner.

You will be based in São Paulo and will report directly to executives at Vammo

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and execute high-impact strategic projects that directly influence Vammo's operational and financial performance.
  • Partner with functional leaders to identify bottlenecks, design solutions, and drive implementation.
  • Build analytical frameworks and dashboards to inform decision-making across the company.
  • Develop business cases, models, and strategic plans for new initiatives — from asset financing structures to expansion playbooks.
  • Own key cross-functional workstreams (e.g., pricing, network expansion, strategic partnerships).
  • Translate insights into clear recommendations and operational action.
  • Work closely with the founders and leadership team on fundraising, board materials, and strategic communications.
  • Build and mentor small, high-performing project teams as the function scales.

Requirements

  • 4-6 years of total experience, ideally including:

2–4 years at a top-tier management consulting firm (BCG, Bain, McKinsey, etc.)

3–4 years in a high-growth startup or operating role where you owned key projects end-to-end.

  • Proven track record of leading and executing complex, cross-functional initiatives.
  • Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills — comfortable in Excel, PowerPoint, and with messy data.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, prioritize ruthlessly, and move fast.
  • Strong business judgment and curiosity about how hardware, logistics, and software intersect.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese; Spanish or Chinese a plus.
  • Based in São Paulo, with willingness to travel domestically and internationally as needed.
  • Strong alignment with Vammo's mission and values.

Benefits

  • A front-row seat at one of Latin America's most ambitious hardware and climate tech startups, backed by world-class investors.
  • A mission-driven environment where every decision contributes to decarbonizing mobility and empowering low-income workers.
  • Exposure to all areas of the business — you'll work directly with the founders and leadership team on company-defining decisions.
  • Freedom to take on as much responsibility as you can handle — and grow faster than anywhere else.
  • Competitive compensation and equity package.
  • Health insurance and benefits.
  • A collaborative, fast-paced, and purpose-driven team that loves to build real things in the real world.

Vammo is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity and inclusion. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, gender identity, or any other protected factor.

title: NetSuite Developer
description:
**To apply, kindly submit your resume in English. Please note that any other format will not be considered.**

Who we are:

Kajae is a premium staff augmentation company that connects top global talents to thriving US companies and clients offering fully remote opportunities. Our team hails from over 27 different countries, with the majority coming from the Philippines and Latin America. We pride ourselves on our tight-knit culture and strong bonds, despite working remotely across diverse timezones.

Benefits:

Competitive salary – paid in USD - Receive your compensation in US dollars, providing stability and global value for your hard work.

100% fully remote setup - Work from anywhere in the world—permanently. Enjoy the freedom and flexibility of a remote role while staying close to what matters most. No more commuting hassles, and more time for life's important moments.

Healthy work-life balance - We prioritize your well-being. Through regular check-ins during your first few months, we offer ongoing support and career guidance. We also ensure you're partnered with top-tier clients in a positive, healthy work environment.

Health insurance - Get covered starting your third month with us—your health and peace of mind matter.

Mental health support - Our in-house mental health professional is available to ensure you have access to the emotional and psychological support you need to thrive.

Referral bonuses - Know someone great? Refer them and earn up to USD 100 for every successful hire.

Fun virtual events - We host monthly virtual events filled with games, holiday celebrations, and exciting prizes. It's a great way to connect and recharge as a team.

Kajae Spotlight bonus - Exceptional performance is recognized through our Kajae Spotlight program, where top performers earn cash rewards.

Kajae Tribe and rewards platform - Engage with the whole team through our internal social platform and earn coins for participating. Use them to bid in our lively auctions for prizes like AirPods, Apple Watches, Starbucks gift cards, shopping or experience vouchers, and more.

Continuing education opportunities - Access 100% free online courses through our university partners in the US. Earn academic credits that can go toward a Master's or Graduate Degree—completely on us.

All-expense paid summits - Top performers and tenured team members may qualify to attend our exclusive annual summits. So far, we've held summits in Palawan, Bohol, and Boracay (Philippines), Cusco (Peru), and Punta Cana (Dominican Republic).

About the Role

We are seeking a talented NetSuite Software Developer who is passionate about building scalable, high-performing applications that integrate seamlessly across business systems. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in modern JavaScript frameworks (Vue, React, or Angular), NodeJS backend development, and experience scripting within NetSuite. This position requires both creativity and technical depth to develop integrations, APIs, and dynamic web interfaces while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.

Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development: Build modern, responsive front-end interfaces using Vue.js (or similar frameworks such as React or Angular).
  • Back-End Development: Develop and maintain robust NodeJS services that handle data integration and automation.
  • API Integration: Design, implement, and maintain RESTful API endpoints that connect enterprise systems.
  • System Integration: Create and manage integrations between NetSuite and third-party platforms such as Business Central, QuickBooks Online, and Salesforce.
  • NetSuite Scripting: Develop and maintain SuiteScript solutions to enhance NetSuite functionality and improve workflow efficiency.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with project managers, designers, and other developers to solve complex technical challenges and ensure successful delivery.
  • Innovation: Continuously explore new technologies and methods to improve performance, scalability, and maintainability across systems.

Requirements:

  • Develop and maintain backend systems using Node.js and modern JavaScript frameworks (Vue, Angular, or React).
  • Design and implement APIs, integrations, and backend logic for enterprise solutions.
  • Work with third-party APIs and enterprise systems to ensure seamless data flow.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.
  • Candidates must have a strong foundation in NetSuite, either as a Functional Consultant or Technical Consultant.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with accounting concepts or financial software.
  • Experience with enterprise SaaS platforms (NetSuite, Salesforce, etc.).
  • Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure, AWS).
  • Background in ERP systems or business process automation.
  • Experience with CRM integrations and data synchronization workflows.
